what: The tests that are meant to keep the linter from exempting anything stay green while it is told to skip code, in three ways: an unused import allowed by name inside ruff.toml (a [lint.pyflakes] allowed-unused-imports line), a second ruff.toml placed in a folder that switches every rule off there, and a '# ruff: noqa' line at the top of a file that silences that whole file. In each case Ruff reports nothing for a file with an unused import, and every test in tests/test_lint.py still passes, so the judge can be weakened without a red check; the spec asks that no rule, file or folder be exempted. The cause is that the exemption test only looks for seven named keys in the root ruff.toml, rather than holding the file to exactly the keys agreed (target-version, extend-exclude, and select under [lint]), and nothing looks for other Ruff config files or for file-level noqa lines in the code. Ticket 04's pull-request notice watches only ruff.toml by name, so a folder-level config would also pass unannounced there; fixing the test now is one change, before tickets 02 and 04 build on it.
